environment.description: Celery worker running as celery user on Ubuntu 22.04 VM, connected to OpenLDAP 2.6 directory server. Worker process has full network access to LDAP server on port 389. The HR webhook API passes username/department fields directly to task arguments without sanitization. LDAP bind account (svc-provisioner) has read access to entire directory tree and write access to ou=groups.

config.ldap_server: OpenLDAP 2.6, unpatched, no query size limits
config.network: Worker has direct TCP access to ldap://directory.internal:389
config.input_validation: none - webhook payload passed directly to celery task
